name: celebration-event-planner
description: AI-powered Celebration & Event Planner for weddings, birthdays, and community events

scripts.dev: node node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs watch server/src/server.ts" "node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js client"
scripts.test: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs --config server/vitest.config.ts run && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs --config client/vitest.config.ts run
scripts.lint: npm run --workspace=server lint && npm run --workspace=client lint

author: PromptWars Challenge 5 Candidate
